sentence: Never ELIC a nonchalorkout already walking out the door.

wombos.definition: A nonchalant John Pork-style crashout — a meltdown delivered with unsettling calm.
wombos.example: He quit his job in a full nonchalorkout — no emotion, just walked out.

wombos.definition: Explain it like I'm Clavic — a request to break something down at a foundational, beginner-friendly level, as if explaining it to someone who is clavic on the topic.
wombos.example: I've never seen the show — can you ELIC the whole plot?
